description:
Episode 225. "Come out of her my people" This call refers to God's people stuck in Babylon, but who and what is this Babylon that is referred to? Who and what is God's remnant church and how does it fit in with the Laodicean church of Revelation? How can we be sure that we are part of the true final remnant church?
